title: Nourishing Corn and Quinoa Soup
subtitle: with Harissa and Silverbeet
description: When you're looking for something comforting and nourishing, this soup fits the bill. With protein-rich quinoa, corn, sweet potato and silverbeet, plus a lively kick from the harissa seasoning, this one's a winner.

steps.text: Prep ingredients: Peel the sweet potato, then cut into 1.5cm chunks. Thinly slice the silverbeet leaves and stems. Pick the coriander leaves and finely chop the stems. Crush or finely chop 2 garlic cloves. Discard the husk and silks from the corn, then slice the kernels from the cob. Put the quinoa in a sieve, then rinse well and drain.

Fry sweet potato: Heat 1 tbs olive oil in a medium saucepan over medium heat. Add the sweet potato, silverbeet stems, coriander stems and garlic, season with salt and pepper and cook, stirring, for 3 mins or until the sweet potato is golden. Add the harissa seasoning (see Kitchen notes) and cook, stirring, for 1 min or until fragrant.

Simmer soup: Add the quinoa, tomatoes and 500ml (2 cups) boiling water to the pan, season with salt and pepper and bring to the boil. Reduce the heat to medium and cook for 8 mins or until slightly reduced.

Add silverbeet and corn: Add the silverbeet leaves, corn and 1 tsp red wine vinegar to the soup and cook, stirring, for 4 mins or until the veggies and quinoa are tender. Remove the pan from the heat. Taste, then season with salt and pepper.
Serve up: Divide the soup among bowls, scatter over the coriander leaves and enjoy (see Kitchen notes).

Kitchen notes: Our harissa seasoning has a mild chilli kick. For those who prefer less heat, use a little less. ~ The quinoa will continue to absorb the liquid in the soup, so serve straight away. Or simply add a little boiling water to loosen it a bit, if needed.
